Data.purpose: Afficher discrètement les métadonnées de version réellement actives sans dupliquer les numéros dans le HTML.

inventory.rule: Inventory entries resolve CURRENT/TEST or equivalent pointers from the same canonical registry.

rules: Never hard-code displayed version numbers in page markup.
Never hard-code release dates in page markup.
The footer must resolve versions from a canonical runtime registry, manifest or bootstrap payload.
A surface/tool version must be the exact version object that was resolved for the current page.
A build reference may use a short immutable SHA or equivalent runtime identifier.
Missing metadata degrades to an explicit unknown marker rather than an invented value.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Composant canonique d’affichage des versions de site, surface et build.
